newsItems.title: OpenAI Engineer Accused of Spying on Executives Ordered to Remain in Custody
newsItems.summary: A judge ordered Abdulrahman Alfozan to remain in custody, likening the Saudi government’s offer to secure the former OpenAI engineer’s release to a “blank check.”
newsItems.whyItMatters: 基础模型能力、价格和开放策略的变化，会迅速传导到整个应用生态。
newsItems.titleZh: OpenAI 工程师被指控对高管进行间谍活动，被勒令继续拘留
newsItems.summaryZh: 法官命令阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿尔福赞 (Abdulrahman Alfozan) 继续被拘留，并将沙特政府释放前 OpenAI 工程师的提议比作“空白支票”。

newsItems.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
newsItems.summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 算力供给、能效与成本决定模型能否稳定地走向规模化应用。
newsItems.titleZh: 亚马逊通过新的 TorchNeuron 开发工具向 Nvidia 发起了迄今为止最大的攻击
newsItems.summaryZh: 亚马逊希望打破 Nvidia 对 PyTorch（用于构建大多数人工智能应用程序的免费工具包）的控制，以便更多开发人员在像自己的芯片一样的替代芯片上运行他们的应用程序。

newsItems.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
newsItems.summary: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 智能体能否连接工具并稳定完成任务，决定 AI 从回答问题走向交付结果的速度。
newsItems.titleZh: 黑客攻击人工智能编码工具 OpenCode，对用户的人工智能账户收取费用
newsItems.summaryZh: OpenCode 是一种开源 AI 编码代理，已成为 Claude 代码和光标的流行替代品。但黑客侵入了其在线平台的一部分并窃取了一些用户的 API 密钥，而其寻求帮助的人工智能工具却始终拒绝查看恶意代码。

newsItems.summary: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

newsItems.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
